answer: Proof-of-latency-bounded-work resists sybils: each identity must return a correct answer to a compute challenge within a tight latency bound measured from an unpredictable issue time, so neither precomputation nor outsourcing to a shared backend fits the window. A pearl of fakes routing through one ember of shared compute serializes behind that backend and blows the latency bound; an honest agent with dedicated local compute answers in time. The opal-tight deadline binds work to per-identity local capacity that a shared farm cannot parallelize fast enough.
